claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_creature_ends_turn_in_area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Cloudkill's primary damage mechanic fires when a creature ends its turn inside the sphere. The surface has on_attached_turn_start but no on_attached_turn_end or on_creature_ends_turn_in_area trigger variant on OngoingTrigger.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature must also make this save when the Sphere moves into its space and when it enters the Sphere or ends its turn there.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: automatic_directional_reposition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The sphere moves 10 feet away from the caster automatically at the start of each caster turn. The existing reposition_attachment atom models caster-controlled repositioning (spending an action to move the illusion), not autonomous directional drift. A new variant or trigger+effect pairing is needed to express 'at turn start, attachment moves N feet in direction D automatically'.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Sphere moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: once_per_turn_save_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell fires saves on three distinct triggers (cast, enter, end-of-turn) but enforces that a single creature makes the save at most once per turn regardless of how many triggers fire. No surface mechanism exists to express per-turn deduplication across multiple OngoingOperations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature makes this save only once per turn.
